subject: Committed Spend: contingency plan, invoice routing & priority collection
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@lithehealth.com>

Cc: Sophie Tran <sophie.tran@lithehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Committed spend schedule — immediate question on failures

Hi Jonas,

Quick one — finance has flagged a concern around our Q2 committed spend schedule (see attached Signed_SOW_LitheHealth_Q2-2026.pdf). If a scheduled monthly drawdown fails (bank transfer rejected, currency routing delays, or VAT mismatch), what are Redwood's operational fallbacks? Lithe needs a documented escalation and a prioritized collection flow so we can reconcile with our treasury.

Specifically:
- Is there an automated retry window and how many attempts?
- Can we opt for a short-term credit against a future invoice to avoid service interruption?
- Who on Redwood's side owns the tax/VAT reclassification paperwork if our AP submits the wrong VAT id?

Appreciate a short plan we can attach to our internal control notes.

— Oliver
Finance Lead, LitheHealth
[Attachment: Signed_SOW_LitheHealth_Q2-2026.pdf]

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@lithehealth.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 10:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Committed spend schedule — contingency & prioritized collection flow

Hi Oliver — thanks for flagging this (appreciate the attachment). Summary below is what Redwood will commit to operationally for RDW-5893; we can convert to a one-page runbook for your control folder.

High-level contingency steps (applies to monthly prepaid drawdowns):
1) Automatic retry logic — 3 attempts across a 72-hour window. Retries use exponential backoff: +6h, +24h, +48h.
2) Soft hold grace — if retries fail, we place a 7-calendar-day service grace period. Within that window we will not throttle production traffic but will disable non-essential features (batch export, long-running eval jobs) to limit burn.
3) Temporary credit option — we can issue a one-time short-term credit equal to the missed drawdown amount (up to one month of committed spend) to prevent immediate disruption. This requires a signed authorization form and is limited to customers with cleared KYC.
4) Escrow & fallback — if client elects escrow on day 1 of the contract we will move to the escrow drawdown (immediate transfer out) protocol, otherwise we follow the retry + credit flow.
5) VAT/tax mismatch owner — Redwood Finance (cc: Kimberly) will own the initial reconciliation with your AP and provide a VAT evidence template. If reclassification is required, Redwood will supply documentation and a spreadsheet mapping the corrected VAT ids.

Operational contacts:
- Primary collection owner: kimberly_park@redwood.ai (Finance Ops)
- Account owner: marissa_cole@redwood.ai (Customer Success / AM)
- Exec escalation: jonas_weber@redwood.ai

Next steps I propose:
- Kimberly to confirm the exact invoice numbering convention and PO handling (below).
- Marissa to send a short DocuSign addendum to allow the one-time temporary credit flow (if you want it enabled).
- I’ll attach a concise drawdown runbook to HubSpot and your Drive folder.

PO / invoice guidance (for your AP team):
- Invoice reference: RDW-5893 / LITHE-PO-{{month}}
- Currency routing: EUR (primary) with GBP/EUR alternate rails (specify IBAN + SWIFT for cross-border)
- VAT handling: if Lithe provides valid EU VAT id, Redwood zero-rates the invoice where applicable; if VAT id invalid we will charge VAT and issue a corrective credit once evidence is provided.

I’ve attached a draft MutualActionPlan.docx to this thread; Kimberly, please add the invoice numbering convention and confirm the retry windows in writing.

Best,
Jonas
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Draft_MutualActionPlan.docx]

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 13 Mar 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Committed spend schedule — contingency & invoice conventions

Hi all — confirming operational pieces from Finance Ops for the runbook:

- Invoice numbering format: RDW-5893-LITHE-YYYYMM (we will generate the invoice and include your PO field LITHE-PO-XXXX if provided).
- Retry details: Jonas captured this accurately (3 retries, 72h total). We will also send an AP notification email after the 2nd failed attempt listing the next retry window.
- Credit approval: temporary credit up to one monthly committed amount requires AM + Finance sign-off (Marissa + me). Once signed, credits post within 24 hours and appear on the next invoice as a line item.
- VAT evidence: please upload your VAT spreadsheet to the Drive link. If your VAT id changes after an invoice posts, we will issue a reversing credit and a corrected invoice; allow 5 business days for processing.

Attachment: LitheHealth_VAT_Evidence.xlsx — Oliver, please confirm the VAT id column (column C) matches the ids your AP will submit.

Kimberly Park
Finance Operations, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: LitheHealth_VAT_Evidence.xlsx]
